local function SendChatMessage(message)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local textChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if textChannel then
            textChannel:SendAsync(message)
        end
    else
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(message, "All")
    end
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local difference = hrp.Position - targetHRP.Position

                if difference.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local vec = difference.Unit
                    local dot = math.clamp(targetLook:Dot(vec), -1, 1)
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(dot))

                    if angle <= maxAngle then
                        local dist = difference.Magnitude

                        if dist < closestDist then
                            closestDist = dist
                            closest = hrp
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

-- Dragging
-- The decorative Star Platinum and menacing images are children of mainFrame,
-- so they automatically move with the controller.
do
    local dragging = false
    local dragStart = Vector2.new()
    local startPos = mainFrame.Position

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            -- Don't drag when clicking controls or decorative images.
            if input.Target == closeBtn
                or input.Target == guiToggle
                or input.Target == targetBox
                or input.Target == standBtn
                or input.Target == punchBtn
                or input.Target == posBox
                or input.Target == offBox
                or input.Target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if dragging then
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            local delta = mousePos - dragStart

            local newX = math.clamp(
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X - mainFrame.Size.X.Offset
            )

            local newY = math.clamp(
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
                0,
                workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y - mainFrame.Size.Y.Offset
            )

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, newX, 0, newY)
        end
    end)
end


local function findTargetByName(namePart)
    if not namePart or namePart == "" then
        return nil
    end

    namePart = namePart:lower()

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Name:lower():find(namePart) then
            return p
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local standOn = false
local bp, gyro = nil, nil
local floatTime = 0

local vanished = false
local savedCharacterCFrame = nil
local savedCameraSubject = nil

local VANISH_HEIGHT = 1000

local BLOCK_DISTANCE = 3
local blocking = false

local function enableStand()
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end

    if not bp then
        bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
        bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        bp.P = 2000
        bp.D = 50
        bp.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
        bp.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end

    if not gyro then
        gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        gyro.P = 2000
        gyro.D = 50
        gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        gyro.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        gyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end
end

local function disableStand()
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = true
        end
    end

    if bp then
        bp:Destroy()
        bp = nil
    end

    if gyro then
        gyro:Destroy()
        gyro = nil
    end
end

standBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    standOn = not standOn

    standBtn.Text = standOn
        and "「 STAND: ON 」"
        or "「 STAND: OFF 」"

    if standOn then
        enableStand()

        local t = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            for _, id in ipairs(summonSoundIds) do
                local summon = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
                summon.SoundId = id

            end
        end

        SendChatMessage(
            "I am now your stand, type these in chat to control me, VANISH, SUMMON, BARRAGE, BLOCK, UNBLOCK"
        )
    else
        blocking = false
        disableStand()
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if standOn and bp and gyro and targetBox.Text ~= "" then

        if vanished and savedCharacterCFrame then
            bp.Position = Vector3.new(
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.Z
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                bp.Position,
                bp.Position + savedCharacterCFrame.LookVector
            )

            return
        end

        floatTime += dt * 2
        local floatOffset = math.sin(floatTime) * 0.5

        local t = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetHRP = t.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local tcf = targetHRP.CFrame
            local desiredPos

            if blocking then
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    + tcf.LookVector * BLOCK_DISTANCE
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
            else
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    - tcf.LookVector * standDistance
                    + tcf.RightVector * sideOffset
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset + floatOffset, 0)
            end

            bp.Position = bp.Position:Lerp(
                desiredPos,
                math.clamp(followSpeed, 0.01, 1)
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + tcf.LookVector
            )
        end
    end
end)

local function runPastebinStyleFling(duration)
    local start = tick()
    local movel = 0.1

    while tick() - start < duration do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000
                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel
                + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

local function punchTarget()
    local punchAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    punchAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://86464152593138"

    local punchTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(punchAnim)
    punchTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    punchTrack:Play()

    task.delay(1, function()
        if punchTrack then
            punchTrack:Stop()
            punchTrack:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    local targetPlayer = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
        return
    end

    local targetHRP =
        targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not targetHRP then
        return
    end

    SendChatMessage("ORA! ORA! ORA! ORA!")

    local nearest = GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer)

    if not nearest then
        return
    end

    local wasStandOn = standOn

    if wasStandOn then
        standOn = false
        standBtn.Text = "「 STAND: OFF 」"
        disableStand()
    end

scripts.script:
local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local jb = 14

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local joint = root:WaitForChild("RootJoint")
	local c0 = joint.C0
	local on = false

	local function stop()
		if on then
			rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("backflip")
			on = false
		end
		if joint.Parent then
			joint.C0 = c0
		end
	end

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
		if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
			if on then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end
		if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		stop()
		on = true
		local md0 = hum.MoveDirection
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local dir
		if md0.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			dir = -Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		else
			local f = md0:Dot(look)
			local r = md0:Dot(right)
			if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then
				dir = f > 0 and look or -look
			else
				dir = r > 0 and right or -right
			end
		end
		local axis = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis:Cross(dir)).Unit
		local g = workspace.Gravity
		local v = (hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight)) + jb
		local dur = math.max(2 * v / g * 0.95, 0.35)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local boosted = false
		rs:BindToRenderStep("backflip", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			if a >= 1 or hum.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
				stop()
				return
			end
			if not boosted then
				boosted = true
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, jb, 0)
			end
			joint.C0 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, a * math.pi * 2) * c0
		end)
	end)
end

if plr.Character then
	task.spawn(setup, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)

MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- ==========================================
-- MOBILE FINGER & MOUSE DRAGGING ENGINE
-- ==========================================
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, 
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
        startPos.Y.Scale, 
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 25)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
MinBtn.Text = "-"
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 30, 30)
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local FlightButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlightButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 30)

FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
FlightButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlightButton.Parent = MainFrame

-- Directional Controls Frame
local ControlFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 150)
ControlFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
ControlFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ControlFrame.Visible = false
ControlFrame.Parent = MainFrame

-- Helper function to build uniform directional buttons
local function createButton(name, pos, text)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Parent = ControlFrame
    return btn
end

-- Layout direction elements
local UpBtn    = createButton("UpBtn",    UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 5),   "Up")
local LeftBtn  = createButton("LeftBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 50),  "Left")
local RightBtn = createButton("RightBtn", UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50), "Right")
local DownBtn  = createButton("DownBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 95),  "Down")

-- Global States & Physics Trackers
local flightActive = false
local isMinimized = false
local movementVelocity = nil
local rotationGyro = nil
local MOVEMENT_SPEED = 2 

-- References to the active character (changes when you die)
local currentCharacter = nil
local currentHumanoid = nil
local currentRootPart = nil

-- Core function to enable or disable physics setups
local function updatePhysicsState()
    if not currentCharacter or not currentHumanoid or not currentRootPart then return end
    
    -- Clean up any lingering objects from a previous character life
    if movementVelocity then movementVelocity:Destroy() movementVelocity = nil end
    if rotationGyro then rotationGyro:Destroy() rotationGyro = nil end
    
    if flightActive then
        FlightButton.Text = "DISABLE"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
        if not isMinimized then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = MOVEMENT_SPEED
        
        -- Orient character flat immediately
        local flatTargetCFrame = currentRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        currentRootPart.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame
        
        -- Apply locking forces
        rotationGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        rotationGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5) 
        rotationGyro.D = 100 
        rotationGyro.P = 10000 
        rotationGyro.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame 
        rotationGyro.Parent = currentRootPart
        
        movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        movementVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6) 
        movementVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) 
        movementVelocity.Parent = currentRootPart
    else
        FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        currentRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRootPart.Position)
    end
end

    currentCharacter = newCharacter
    currentHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    currentRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Instantly enforce the flight/flat physics if it was left ON when you died
    updatePhysicsState()
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

    else

        MinBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Manual UI Toggle Button Press Listener

end)

-- Velocity Controller Direction mapping

    movementVelocity.Velocity = directionVector * MOVEMENT_SPEED
end

local function startFlying()
	character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
	
	local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
	
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	bg.CFrame = hrp.CFrame

	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp or not humanoid then return end

		if _G.isNoclip then
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == true then
					part.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- 2. Thumbstick Logic (Horizontal Only)
		local moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		
		if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z).Unit
			local flatRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
			flatRight = Vector3.new(flatRight.X, 0, flatRight.Z).Unit
			
			local localMoveDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDirection)
			flatVelocity = (flatLook * -localMoveDirection.Z) + (flatRight * localMoveDirection.X)
			
			if flatVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
				flatVelocity = flatVelocity.Unit * _G.flySpeed
			end
		end

		bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(flatVelocity.X, verticalVelocityY, flatVelocity.Z)
		
		-- 4. Dynamic Tilt Engine (Faces camera look view)
		local camLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camLook)
	end)

-- Executor support cheking
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local function Notify(title, text, duration)
    duration = duration or 4

    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = title,
        Text = text,
        Duration = duration
    })

    task.spawn(function()
        local notificationGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") 
            and CoreGui.RobloxGui:FindFirstChild("NotificationFrame")

        if not notificationGui then
            for _, v in pairs(CoreGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if v.Name == "NotificationFrame" or v.Name == "Notification" then
                    notificationGui = v
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if notificationGui then
            notificationGui.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            notificationGui.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
        end
    end)
end

local function getExecutorName()
    if identifyexecutor then
        local name, version = identifyexecutor()
        return name or "Unknown", version
    elseif getexecutorname then
        return getexecutorname(), nil
    end
    return "Unknown", nil
end

local function isSupported()
    local hasHttp = typeof(game.HttpGet) == "function"
    local hasLoadstring = typeof(loadstring) == "function"
    local hasRequest = typeof(request) == "function" or (syn and typeof(syn.request) == "function")
    return hasHttp and hasLoadstring and hasRequest
end

local execName = getExecutorName()

if not isSupported() then
    Notify("CFrameFly", "Executor not supported!\nDetected: " .. execName, 5)
    return
end

Notify("CFrameFly", "Supported: " .. execName .. "\nLoading script...", 3)

    bg.Parent = rootPart

            end
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
        end
    end)

if playerGui:FindFirstChild("FlyUI") then
	playerGui.FlyUI:Destroy()
end

local speeds = {55, 95, 145}
local stage = 0
local flying = false
local flyConn
local bv, bg
local ikList = {}
local poseParts = {}
local windBits = {}
local lookPart, lookAtt, lookIK
local windSound
local windLevel = 0
local windShowing = false

local function getParts()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	return char, char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"), char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end

local function resetNeck(char)
	local upper = char and char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local neck = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Neck")
	local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
	if neck then neck.Transform = CFrame.identity end
	if waist then waist.Transform = CFrame.identity end
end

local function clearLook()
	if lookIK then lookIK:Destroy() lookIK = nil end
	if lookPart then lookPart:Destroy() lookPart = nil end
	lookAtt = nil
end

local function clearWind()
	for _, obj in ipairs(windBits) do
		if obj then obj:Destroy() end
	end
	windBits = {}
	if windSound then
		windSound:Stop()
		windSound:Destroy()
		windSound = nil
	end
	windShowing = false
end

local function clearPose()
	for _, ik in ipairs(ikList) do
		if ik then ik:Destroy() end
	end
	ikList = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(poseParts) do
		if part then part:Destroy() end
	end
	poseParts = {}
	clearLook()
	resetNeck(player.Character)
end

local function makeTarget(parent, offset)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "InvisibleFlyTarget"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Anchored = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.Parent = parent
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = parent
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(offset)
	weld.Parent = part
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	table.insert(poseParts, part)
	return attachment
end

local function addIK(hum, endPart, rootPart, target, pole)
	if not endPart or not rootPart or not target then return end
	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
	ik.EndEffector = endPart
	ik.ChainRoot = rootPart
	ik.Target = target
	if pole then ik.Pole = pole end
	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.05
	ik.Parent = hum
	table.insert(ikList, ik)
end

local function startLookUp(char, hum)
	clearLook()
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end
	lookPart = Instance.new("Part")
	lookPart.Name = "HeadLookTarget"
	lookPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	lookPart.Transparency = 1
	lookPart.Anchored = true
	lookPart.CanCollide = false
	lookPart.CanQuery = false
	lookPart.Parent = workspace
	lookAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	lookAtt.Parent = lookPart
	lookIK = Instance.new("IKControl")
	lookIK.Type = Enum.IKControlType.LookAt
	lookIK.EndEffector = head
	lookIK.ChainRoot = head
	lookIK.Target = lookAtt
	lookIK.Weight = 1
	lookIK.SmoothTime = 0.05
	lookIK.Parent = hum
end

local function lockTorso(char)
	local upper = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local lower = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
	local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
	local root = lower and lower:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if waist then waist.Transform = CFrame.identity end
	if root then root.Transform = CFrame.identity end
end

local function applyHoverPose(char, hum)
	clearPose()
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.55, -0.55)))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightHand"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.35, 0.35, -0.55)))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.55, -2.35, 0.45)))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.55, -2.35, 0.45)))
end

local function applyFlightPose(char, hum)
	clearPose()
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	local leftHand = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-1.15, 2.8, 0.05))
	local rightHand = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(1.15, 2.8, 0.05))
	local leftFoot = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.28, -2.85, 0.05))
	local rightFoot = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.28, -2.85, 0.05))
	local leftPole = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.28, -1.2, 0.35))
	local rightPole = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.28, -1.2, 0.35))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), leftHand)
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightHand"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), rightHand)
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), leftFoot, leftPole)
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), rightFoot, rightPole)
	startLookUp(char, hum)

	a0.Parent = hrp

	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	stage = 0
	windLevel = 0
	btn.Text = "VOAR"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 220)
	if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
	clearPose()
	clearWind()
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			hum.AutoRotate = true
		end
	end
end

local function startFly()
	flying = true
	stage = 1
	btn.Text = "BOOST 1"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 210)

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = hrp

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bg.P = 20000
	bg.D = 1500
	bg.Parent = hrp

	local hovering = false
	local flightPose = false

	flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp.Parent then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		local camCF = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.05
		local speed = speeds[stage] or 55

		if moving then
			if windLevel > 0 and not windShowing then
				setWind(hrp, windLevel)
			end
			lockTorso(char)
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end

			local flyDir = (camCF.LookVector * move:Dot(flatLook)) + (camCF.RightVector * move:Dot(flatRight))
			if flyDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				flyDir = flyDir.Unit
				bv.Velocity = flyDir * speed
				bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + flyDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
				if lookPart then
					lookPart.Position = hrp.Position + flyDir * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				end
			end

			if hovering then
				clearPose()
				hovering = false
			end
			if not flightPose then
				applyFlightPose(char, hum)
				flightPose = true
			end
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			bg.CFrame = camCF
			if windShowing then
				local saved = windLevel
				clearWind()
				windLevel = saved
			end
			if flightPose then
				clearPose()
				flightPose = false
			end
			if not hovering then
				applyHoverPose(char, hum)
				hovering = true
			end
		end
	end)
end
